cases.goal: Sustain tension, distinguish narration from dialogue, and preserve character turns across chunks.
cases.delivery: Controlled dramatic narration; do not rush the dialogue.
cases.chunkPolicy: Paragraph and speaker turns are preferred boundaries.

segments.text: She found him in the cavernous quiet of Shuttle Bay 2. The main lights were dimmed, but a portable floodlight cast a harsh glare on the sleek hull of the shuttlecraft Cochrane. She hesitated for a fraction of a second at the threshold. It was the same shuttle. The one he had used to kidnap her, the one that had taken them past the known universe and into a shared, unspoken hell. Of course he was still working on it.

He was on his back on a mechanic's creeper, half-submerged beneath the shuttle's impulse engine housing, the focused hiss of a micro-welder echoing in the silence. The air smelled of ozone and engine coolant.

Her footsteps on the deck plating were unnaturally loud. The welding stopped. The creeper slid out, and he sat up, wiping his hands on an already-filthy rag. He shielded his eyes against his own light, squinting to see who was there.
He stood, his expression shifting from surprise to immediate concern as she stepped into the light. He saw it on her face instantly.
Tom froze. He searched her face, understanding dawning slowly. He let out a low whistle, a sound that was equal parts shock and grudging admiration.

cases.goal: Read dense technical material as calm, intelligible narration rather than a list of acronyms.
cases.delivery: Measured and composed, with short pauses around numbers and capability boundaries.
cases.chunkPolicy: Sentence boundaries are mandatory; keep contrasts in the same chunk when capacity permits.

segments.text: Kokoro-Hexagon runs the Kokoro eighty-two-million-parameter speech model on a Galaxy S23. The current end-to-end speech path uses precompiled FP16 QNN contexts on the Hexagon processor.

A direct HMX probe has also produced an exact W4A8 matrix result for one sixty-four by thirty-two by thirty-two contraction. That proves the instruction encoding and packed layout used by the probe; it does not yet prove a quantized Kokoro model.
The PowerShell runspace binds Android's native AAudio interface at twenty-four kilohertz, mono, floating point. One stream has accepted consecutive chunks without an observed underrun.
The next test keeps the QNN contexts, tensor buffers, and audio stream alive for a complete passage. It measures synthesis, submission, presentation, completion, and peak memory separately.

cases.goal: Preserve line endings, internal rhyme, and an even didactic pulse without flattening the words into prose.
cases.delivery: Rhythmic spoken-word delivery; articulate the variable names and equations.
cases.chunkPolicy: Never split a line. Prefer four-line groups, with the chorus as its own chunk.

lines: Yeah, look at the board, let's break it down,
Don't let the letters make you frown.
See an X or a Y in the middle of the math?
It's just a hidden number waiting on the path.
We call it a variable, a mystery inside,
A guest at the party trying to hide.
The goal of the game is to leave it alone,
Isolate the letter, put it on a throne.
Whatever you do to the left of the sign,
Do it to the right and you're doing just fine!
It's all about balance, keeping the scale,
Follow the golden rule and you will never fail.
Find the X, find the Y, solve the unknown,
Step by step, line by line, till the answer is shown.
